defaults.description: Explore the diverse geography of {name} through our highly optimized, interactive SVG map. Perfect for dashboards, data visualization, and regional targeting.

maps.name: India
maps.description: India is a South Asian country known for its rich cultural heritage, diverse landscapes ranging from the Himalayas to the Indian Ocean, and being the world's most populous democracy.

maps.name: Japan
maps.description: Japan is an island nation in East Asia, famous for its blend of ancient traditions and cutting-edge technology, stunning landscapes, and a culture centered around respect and harmony.

maps.name: Russia
maps.description: Russia is the world's largest country by land area, spanning Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, characterized by its vast forests, rich history, and significant global influence.

maps.name: Mexico
maps.description: Mexico is a North American country known for its rich history, vibrant culture, diverse ecosystems ranging from arid deserts to tropical beaches, and world-renowned cuisine.

maps.name: Italy
maps.description: Italy is a Southern European country shaped like a boot, celebrated for its profound impact on global culture, art, architecture, and its world-famous culinary traditions.

maps.name: South Korea
maps.description: South Korea is an East Asian country known for its rapid economic development, vibrant pop culture, advanced technology, and a beautiful landscape of mountains and coastline.

maps.name: Spain
maps.description: Spain is a southwestern European country known for its diverse culture, rich history, sunny Mediterranean beaches, and significant contributions to art, literature, and global exploration.

maps.name: Indonesia
maps.description: Indonesia is a vast Southeast Asian archipelago comprising thousands of islands, renowned for its incredible biodiversity, diverse cultures, and stunning tropical landscapes.

maps.name: Netherlands
maps.description: The Netherlands is a small, densely populated Western European country famous for its flat landscape of polders, canals, windmills, tulip fields, and a strong cycling culture.

maps.name: Saudi Arabia
maps.description: Saudi Arabia is a Middle Eastern country, the largest on the Arabian Peninsula, known for its vast deserts, significant Islamic holy sites, and major role in the global energy sector.
